(*) Total share capital/ voting capital to be taken as per the latest filing done by the company as on
September 30, 2026 to the Stock Exchange under Clause 35 of the Listing Agreement.
(**) Diluted share/voting capital means the total number of shares in TC assuming full conversion of
the outstanding convertible securities/warrants into equity shares of the TC.
(***) Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS) are non-participating in nature and do not
carry any voting rights. The terms and conditions governing the CCPS are set out in the Letter of Offer
filed by Quint Digital Limited in connection with the issuance of such CCPS on a rights basis. The
percentage indicated represents the aggregate percentage of the total CCPS currently held by RB
Diversified Private Limited. As CCPS are non-participating and do not carry any voting rights, their
acquisition does not trigger an open offer obligation under Regulation 3(2) of the SEBI (SAST)
Regulations, 2011.
(****) Out of the total 44,84,838 CCPS; 29,32,138 CCPS have already been disclosed under
Regulation 29(2) vide disclosure dated October 27, 2026.
